# Skilling

> An open format for AI-tutored courses. Learners use a local workspace through Claude Code or
> Codex; authors publish portable course directories. Specification version 1.4.0-draft.

## Learners

- [Start learning](README.md#start-learning): Persistent installation and the pinned Welcome course.
- [Learn with Skilling](docs/learning-a-course.md): First lesson, resume, progress, homework, learner work and moving a workspace.
- [Course sources](docs/course-sources.md): Supported GitHub, Git and local refs, credentials, snapshots and offline limits.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): Installation, PATH, skill discovery, source and recovery help.
- [Examples](examples/README.md): Welcome, hello-skilling and workbench.

## Authors

- [Author a course](docs/authoring-a-course.md): Scaffold, write, validate, preview, tag and publish.
- [Course format](spec/course-format.md): Normative author-facing format.
- [Error codes](docs/error-codes.md): Validator finding catalogue.
- [Specification changelog](spec/CHANGELOG.md): Normative changes and errata.

## Implementers and specification

- [Specification index](spec/README.md): Scope, versions and conformance classes.
- [Runtime](spec/runtime.md): Normative delivery and persistence behaviour.
- [Workspace](spec/workspace.md): Normative learner workspace layout and discovery.
- [Skill pack](spec/skill-pack.md): Normative host skill conventions.
- [Python file session](docs/python-session.md): Experimental trusted-controller facade and safe teaching views.
- [Implement a runtime](docs/implementing-a-runtime.md): Reference implementation guide.
- [Known implementations](docs/implementations.md): Registry and claim limits.
- [Delivery loop](docs/concepts/the-delivery-loop.md): Explanatory concept.
- [Open gates](docs/concepts/open-gates.md): Explanatory concept.
- [Learner record](docs/concepts/the-learner-record.md): Explanatory concept.
- [What the record knows](docs/concepts/what-the-record-knows.md): Capabilities and evidence.
- [Homework mailbox](docs/concepts/the-homework-mailbox.md): Review and submission mechanics.
- [Telemetry sink](docs/concepts/the-telemetry-sink.md): Opt-in trace constraints.
- [Mechanism and policy](docs/concepts/mechanism-and-policy.md): What adopters decide.

## Embed in an application

- [Embed a tutor](website/guides/embed/index.md): Application integration guide and source API status.
- [React quickstart](website/guides/embed/quickstart.md): Install and run the reference application.
- [FastAPI integration](website/guides/embed/fastapi.md): Agent configuration, authentication and authorization.
- [React streaming](website/guides/embed/react.md): HTTP events, render acknowledgements and learner controls.
- [Operations](website/guides/embed/operate.md): Persistence, retries, deployment and recovery.
- [Session integration reference](docs/embedding-a-tutor.md): Trusted scopes, backend configuration and lower-level APIs.
- [SQLite persistence](docs/persistence.md): Complete aggregate persistence and backup/restore.
- [PostgreSQL persistence](docs/persistence-postgres.md): Pools, conflicts and operational recovery.
- [S3 persistence](docs/persistence-s3.md): Conditional writes, ambiguous outcomes and backup/restore.
- [Python tutor API](docs/python-tutor.md): Lower-level conversational policy and informal reviews.
- [React tutor example](examples/react-tutor/README.md): Canonical application launch and configuration reference.
